newsitem.title: USA: EX-DILLON READ MUNI SALESMEN JOIN OPPENHEIMER.
newsitem.headline: EX-DILLON READ MUNI SALESMEN JOIN OPPENHEIMER.

text.p: Former Dillon Read & Co municipal bond salesmen Howard Feldman and Robert Marron have joined Oppenheimer & Co's muni department as senior vice presidents of institutional sales, Oppenheimer's co-director of fixed income said Wednesday.

Feldman joined Oppenheimer in late July, while Marron came aboard August 4, William Frazier, a managing director and co-director of fixed income at the firm, said. Both had been senior vice presidents at Dillon Read, which exited the municipal bond business in June, Frazier said.
"They were top professionals who had relationships that complemented the relationships we had in house," he said.
Frazier do not rule out additional hires.
"We're always talking to people, and we've been fortunate to recruit (Feldman and Marron)," he said. "On the retail side I recently hired Ed Collins."
Formerly of JJ Kenny, Collins joined Oppenheimer as a vice president in retail sales and trading in early July, Frazier said.
